OFFICE LEASE AGREEMENT

This Office Lease Agreement (this "Lease") is made as of January 15, 2024, between Example Properties LLC ("Landlord") and Sample Tenant Inc. ("Tenant").

ARTICLE 2. TERM

Section 2.1 Commencement Date. The term of this Lease shall commence on March 1, 2024 (the "Commencement Date") and shall expire on February 28, 2029, unless sooner terminated.

ARTICLE 3. RENT

Section 3.1 Base Rent. Tenant shall pay annual base rent in equal monthly installments as follows:

Lease Year | Annual Base Rent | Monthly Installment
Year 1 | $120,000.00 | $10,000.00
Year 2 | $123,600.00 | $10,300.00
Year 3 | $127,308.00 | $10,609.00

Section 3.2 Additional Rent. Tenant shall pay its proportionate share of Operating Expenses.
